description:
What is This Part?
This is a COMPLETE SET of Front & Rear Engine Mounts
Mounts for Both Sides of the Engine and Under the Transmission (aka Rear Engine).
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Mounts, Engine
Qty 1 – Mount, Transmission (Rear Engine)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
